name: direct-purchase-counted
description: a direct purchase just under 10x the cap: value as published = counted value, no badge, and the over-cap Signal that lists it

name: direct-purchase-suspect
description: a direct purchase at 10x the cap or more: shown, flagged by the 10x-cap rule with its threshold, left out of sums

name: direct-purchase-no-value
description: a direct purchase with no value in SEAP: the no-value badge, nothing counted

name: contract-suspect-over-estimate
description: a contract of 1 bn RON or more at 100x its e-licitatie estimate: shown, flagged, left out of sums

name: contract-suspect-no-estimate
description: a contract above 50 bn RON with no estimate: shown, flagged, left out of sums

name: framework-agreement
description: a framework agreement: ceiling not counted, what its subsequent contracts reported, the ratio, the subsequent contracts listed

name: subsequent-contract
description: a subsequent contract pointing back to its framework agreement

name: framework-blank-ceiling
description: a subsequent contract of a framework with a blank ceiling: reported value, no ceiling, no ratio

name: consortium-with-natural-person
description: a consortium of three, a natural person among them: full value once, an equal share each (a convention), the person unnamed and unlinked

name: not-found
description: no Record under that code

name: contract-single-winner
description: a contract that recurs in a later quarter: one Record carrying the newer notice version, one winner

name: contract-code-with-slash
description: a subsequent contract whose number holds a slash: the code is encoded in the URL and in the redirect link; its framework agreement and ratio

name: framework-consortium
description: a framework contract won by two firms: a ceiling (not counted) and the consortium marker together

name: award-notice-consortium
description: an award notice (not a contract): one Record for the notice, two winners sharing it equally

provenance.via: Anunturi de atribuire la proceduri fara anunt de initiere T1 2025

name: direct-purchase-pipe-title
description: a direct purchase loaded from a pipe-shaped CSV: the title holds a pipe, provenance names the bulk file

name: direct-purchase-notice
description: a direct-purchase award notice (DAN): its own kind, the redirect goes to the award-notice page

provenance.via: Notificari de atribuire la cumpararea directa T I 2024

name: natural-person-winner
description: a winner published with a CNP: a natural person, never named, never linked

name: cui-mismatch
description: a supplier CUI equal to the authority's: unresolved, with the CUI-mismatch badge

name: name-differs-from-anaf
description: the supplier is spelled as ANAF's old name: resolved by CUI, with the name-differs badge

name: identity-curated
description: a wrong CUI mapped by the override file to the entity it really is: curated and name-differs badges

name: consortium-name-only-members
description: a consortium of a CUI firm, a natural person and a foreign firm known by its VAT id

name: bulk-over-crawl
description: a contract the bulk has, crawled too: the bulk version stands, no badge, the redirect link

name: crawl-only
description: a crawled contract the bulk does not have (in a quarter it covers): crawl-only badge, crawl provenance, the e-licitatie page

name: crawled-provisional
description: a crawled contract in a quarter the bulk has not reached: provisional badge, the re-crawled version

name: crawled-request-for-quotation
description: a crawled simplified award notice: provisional, linked to the RFQ page

name: over-cap-signal
description: a direct purchase above the cap: the over-cap Signal with its two Records and its numbers

name: signal-natural-person
description: an over-cap Signal whose only winner is a natural person: no name, no link

name: splitting-signal
description: a direct purchase inside a splitting Signal (three purchases, each under the cap, together over it): the Signal's numbers and its three Records

name: no-publication-signal
description: a backfilled award notice negotiated without prior publication: the no-publication Signal, crawl-only badge and provenance
